statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation. cdi-uploadserver (./cmd/cdi-uploadserver) links one package from the module, github.com/docker/docker/api/types/versions (API version string comparison, pulled in by the registry client). Checked with `go list -deps` at CDI v1.66.1 with docker v28.5.2: no daemon, plugin manager, client or API server package is in the build. The melange build fails if any other docker/docker package is linked. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the github.com/moby/moby module path, so the +incompatible module cannot be floated to it.
